1.1.0.notes: Tooling-only release (skill_version column); rules identical to 1.0.0.

1.2.0.notes: Tooling-only release (skill_name, model_name columns); rules identical to 1.0.0.

2.0.0.notes: Metric gate, rule IDs per candidate, consistency audit; fixes from devdoc 2026100601 (record 416 review).

2.1.0.notes: Statement kind per row (ADR 2026100603); one representation for interpretation cut-offs, conditions, measurement basis, schedules and cited_doc identifiers; A4/X10/X13/A3 clarifications from the 416 audit.

3.0.0.notes: Pure requirements are not metrics (ADR 2026100603 DR1/DR3, openspec exclude-pure-requirements-from-metrics): A2/A3 retired as X15/X16; A4 excludes values set by a cited document or another clause/table.

3.1.0.notes: Clarification from the 416 3.0.0 audit (report 20261007-0854 §3.1): A4 supplies only the value, never the object; a duty to agree an activity's time or frequency is X2; an activity's time slot is not a measurable property.

4.0.0.notes: A duty to set or size a quantity according to another factor, or by design, with no value and no party obliged to declare or agree one, is X17 (sizing duty), not A4: a domain expert reads it as a design requirement. A4 keeps declared and agreed values.

4.1.0.notes: A4 rows are metrics with no value: value_class metric-with-no-value, and metric_desc explains the metric and gives marked typical values (domain knowledge). Same assertions are metrics as in 4.0.0.

5.0.0.notes: Sizing duties (4.x X17) are metrics with no value: A4 now covers values left open to be declared, agreed, or set/sized by another factor or by design. X17 retired.

5.1.0.notes: Typical values of a metric with no value must be a numeric range with unit and what it depends on; 'no comparable typical value' only with a reason why no range can exist. Same metrics as 5.0.0.

6.0.0.notes: A metric has at least a value: A4 and A5 retired, value-less named quantities, formulas and computation definitions are X18; definitions wherever they appear are X3; counts of the document's own parts are X4; provisions with no named quantity are X7; one row per table condition.

6.1.0.notes: Same as 6.0.0 except a symmetric ± tolerance keeps its sign in metric_value (±0.2, not 0.2); validate refuses a bare number when the cited threshold text is ±x.

6.2.0.notes: Same as 6.1.0 except: the same metric stated in several places is one row with all its lines (occurrences, not D1 duplicates); a value stated in prose or a table is not an X13 formula operand.

6.3.0.notes: Same as 6.2.0 except data dictionaries (§2.5): a data element's data format (one row, the whole format) and allowed occurrences are A1, not X3 definitions; notations, code lists and obligation M/O/C are not rows.

6.4.0.notes: Same as 6.3.0 except conditions (§3): condition covers applicability, environment, operating state, test method or apparatus, location, load or time point; the subject names only the object; condition written as <kind>：<value> qualifiers; the same settings under two test methods are two metrics.
